page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94,489 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile presents clear architectural tradeoffs. While the massive local HDD storage capacity offers high volume density for large-scale data retention, the mechanical nature of HDD storage limits random I/O performance compared to solid-state alternatives. Additionally, the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU represents an older processor generation. This makes the instance highly cost-efficient for bulk sequential storage and cold data archiving, but less suitable for workloads requiring high random IOPS or modern CPU instruction sets.

The ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is designed for storage-intensive workloads that require massive local capacity and sequential data access. Suitable use cases include distributed file systems, big data analytics platforms, data warehousing, large-scale log processing, and cold storage archiving.
